finding.title: Localize SyncStatusDegraded.reason in BackupSyncSection._buildDegradedCard's identity-mismatch branch
finding.area: core/sync + features/settings (BackupSyncSection), surfaced by test/e2e/journeys/infra_p1_test.dart E2E-1113

evidence.quote: ? 'Signed in as ${identity.signedInEmail ?? 'a different account'}' ' — sign in as $activeEmail to back up this account.'
skip: true, // BUG R-IC11: see test name above

finding.why: _buildDegradedCard's isMismatch branch (backup_sync_section.dart:145-154) interpolates SyncStatusDegraded.reason directly into the card subtitle with no localization at all, unlike the sibling non-mismatch branch two lines below which explicitly maps stuck-outbox reasons to a friendly ARB string (the 'ST-4 fix'). Because sync_orchestrator.dart hardcodes the mismatch reason as raw English sentences ('Signed in as the wrong account — sign in again to back up.') rather than a stable code/enum, EVERY time a device is signed into the wrong Firebase account with pending changes — a normal, easily reproduced state, not an edge case — Hebrew-locale users see untranslated English in the Backup & Sync card. On top of that, because syncStatusProvider (derived from the orchestrator's own statusStream) and syncIdentityStatusProvider (derived independently from authStateProvider) recompute on unrelated triggers with no atomic coupling, a stale 'outbox has N row(s) stuck after 3+ attempts' engineering string can also transiently appear in the same card. The test that documents this (E2E-1113) keeps the correct assertion but is skipped with only a risk-register id (R-IC11), no Linear ticket, so it will not resurface in planning.
finding.recommendation: Apply the same isStuckOutbox → l10nLocal.backupSyncOutboxStuck substitution in the isMismatch branch before interpolating reason; longer-term, stop authoring English sentences in sync_orchestrator.dart and emit a stable DegradedReason enum that presentation maps 1:1 to ARB keys (removing the substring-sniffing pattern entirely).
acceptance_criteria: Widget test: SyncStatus.degraded(pendingChanges>0, reason: <either hardcoded orchestrator sentence or 'outbox has N row(s) stuck...'>) + SyncIdentityStatus.mismatched(...) renders only localized strings in BackupSyncSection — find.textContaining of the raw English/engineering substrings returns nothing.
